player:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: animation production pose atlas for an original ink-wuxia sword duel.
Reference image is our approved character design and ink-comic style, NOT a layout to repeat.
Create ONE precise 3-column by 2-row sprite atlas of SIX distinct full-body key poses of the SAME dark-robed male swordsman from the near LEFT in the reference. All six face screen RIGHT in three-quarter rear/side view. Adult wuxia swordsman, black ponytail/topknot, layered black/charcoal hanfu robes, offwhite inner panels, small muted vermilion waist sash, dark boots, straight Chinese jian in right hand. Elegant strong anatomy and consistent costume, one sword each.
Use expressive Chinese ink brush contours, clean readable wuxia manhua drawing, high black-white contrast, varied dry brush edges, subtle gray ink wash INSIDE the clothing. Keep every head, hand, boot and entire sword within its own cell, substantial clear gutters, EXACTLY six equally sized square cells, no lines or labels. Uniform scale: standing body height around 65% of each cell.
Reading left to right top to bottom:
1 quiet low guard, upright knees soft, blade diagonally down-right.
2 anticipatory coiled stance, deep bent knees, torso twisted, right hand draws sword back ABOVE right shoulder, tip up-left behind body, left hand extended for balance.
3 explosive rising cut / first clash, deep rightward lunge, right hand in front of chest, sword extends DIAGONALLY UP-RIGHT to a clear contact point near face height; weight on front boot, robe sweeps left.
4 high intercepting guard, left leg back braced, hands around upper chest, blade slopes UP-RIGHT about 50 degrees; upright elbows absorb clash.
5 powerful descending diagonal cut with full follow-through, torso turned right, right hand out right near waist, sword extended DOWN-RIGHT, front knee bent, long coat swings left.
6 recoil and recovery, weight retreats left, sword hand draws blade back across torso pointing diagonally UP-RIGHT, boots planted, torso leans slightly back.
Background: one perfectly FLAT uniform chroma key MAGENTA #ff00ff over the ENTIRE atlas, no texture, no shadows, no floor, no atmospheric effects, no scenery, no gradients. Do not paint magenta on the character. No slash VFX, sparks, text, borders or watermarks. These are separate animation keyframes, not static duplicate portraits. Wide atlas, 3:2 aspect ratio.
opponent:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: SIX full-body animation sprites in one clean 3-column by 2-row atlas.
Use our reference's smaller gray-robed swordsman on the RIGHT as identity reference. This is an ORIGINAL wuxia ink-comic animation character. All six poses SAME adult man, SAME hair topknot and ponytail, SAME pale-gray hanfu with darker wrap and boots, SAME straight Chinese jian, seen in three-quarter FRONT/SIDE view facing screen LEFT. High contrast dry brush line, clean expressive anatomy, restrained gray ink fills, no color except tiny dark muted teal sash. Consistent proportions and scale in every cell.
Each cell square, equal 3 by 2 grid, much empty padding around complete sword and full body, no crop, no overlap, no grid lines, no numbering, no text. Character standing height ~65% of each cell.
Top row left to right:
1 quiet low guard, faces left, blade extends down-left, full body and both boots visible.
2 coiled anticipation for downward cut: knees bent, torso twists right, sword raised above and behind right shoulder to the upper RIGHT of the cell, preparing to swing towards opponent on LEFT.
3 descending cut meets another blade: deep LEFTWARD lunge, sword hand in front of chest at LEFT, blade slopes diagonally UP-LEFT ~45 degrees, body weight forward. Distinct from ready pose.
Bottom row left to right:
4 braced upper parry, knees bent, sword hand at chest, long blade diagonally UP-LEFT, elbows absorb impact, readable face.
5 sweeping LEFTWARD finishing slash, torso twisted towards left, sword hand near waist left, blade slopes DOWN-LEFT, coat streaming right.
6 visible loss-of-balance/recoil: upper body leans right, knees bend, left-facing head recoils slightly, sword arm forced high and to the RIGHT so guard is open towards LEFT. Still standing, no injury, no blood.
TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, alpha zero throughout empty space. No background paint, paper, fog, ground, shadows, VFX, sparks or props; only six isolated fighter sprites. Match approved crisp manhua ink style.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this approved original ink-wuxia artwork into an EMPTY animation background plate. Remove both swordsmen completely, including all swords, loose clothing, shadows belonging to them. Reconstruct the continuous stone mountain terrace and distant mist where they stood. Keep its ink manhua / sumi ink style, strong dry-brush dark framing in the far bottom-left and far right edges, soft pale mountain washes, small pavilion high on right, beautiful layered atmospheric mist. Composition: wide 16:9 establishing shot, level continuous stone terrace extends across bottom 35%; completely open central combat area with no foreground rocks or plants obscuring feet. Clean pale fog fills middle background so dark characters will read. No characters, no creatures, no weapons, no lettering, no interface, no border. Warm offwhite paper with neutral gray ink, extremely restrained muted tones. This is the same setting and camera in the reference, with clear stage space for two full-body swordsmen.
